SaveSlot.title: SaveSlot
SaveSlot.description: Cloud RPG save slot containing hero stats, world position, progression skill tree nodes, inventory items, equipment, and defeated bosses.

slotName.description: Display label for the save slot.

heroName.description: Name of the player's royal bee hero.

xp.description: Current experience points toward next level.

xpToNext.description: Experience points required for next level.

posX.description: Current tile X coordinate on the world map.

posY.description: Current tile Y coordinate on the world map.

currentRegion.description: ID of the current world region.

equippedWeapon.description: Item ID of the equipped weapon or empty string.

equippedShield.description: Item ID of the equipped shield or empty string.

equippedCharm.description: Item ID of the equipped charm or empty string.

unlockedSkills.description: List of unlocked progression tree skill node IDs.

defeatedBosses.description: List of defeated boss or guardian IDs.

openedChests.description: List of opened treasure chest coordinates.

discoveredRegions.description: List of discovered world region IDs.

enemiesDefeated.description: Total number of evil bees defeated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on update (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/save_slots/{slotId}.description: Per-user RPG cloud save slots for Bee Kingdom.
